summary: Paperclip holds only two FDA documents for NDA021948 (ERAXIS/anidulafungin): the combined approval letter (NDAs 21-632 and 21-948) and the product label. No FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Medical Review, or Office Director memo) are available for this application. Both available documents were searched for 'Advisory Committee', 'committee', 'advisory', and 'voted', with no matches; neither document mentions an advisory committee meeting. No evidence of an advisory committee being convened could be found, and no verbatim passage affirmatively states one was or was not held, so adcom_held is set to false with no supporting quote available.
